- [ ] 📄Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️Configuration changes
- [ ] 🔶Other (please describe):

#### Checklist

<!-- Before submitting, please ensure the following have been completed: -->

- [ ] PR is created from the up-to-date branch.
- [ ] I made sure PR is targeted at the correct branch (please double-check where you are trying to merge your code 👌).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added comments to code in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My code is formatted according to linting rules (ESLint, Prettier, etc).
- [ ] I have checked all commits' message styles matches this [guidline](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).
- [ ] My changes don't generate new warnings or errors.
